title: Chrome Gemini Nano Configuration Schema
description: Schema for Chrome Gemini Nano AI session configuration

temperature.description: Controls randomness and creativity. Lower values (0-0.3) for factual responses, higher values (1.0-2.0) for creative content.

topK.description: Number of top tokens to consider. Lower values (1-3) for focused responses, higher values (5-40) for diverse outputs.

systemPrompt.description: System-level instructions that define the AI's role and behavior. Applied to all interactions in the session.

signal.description: AbortSignal for cancelling the session creation or requests. Not directly serializable in JSON.

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens in the response. Higher values allow longer responses but may impact performance.

timeout.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. Recommended range: 10-60 seconds.

examples.systemPrompt: You are a precise technical assistant. Provide accurate, concise answers.
You are a creative writing assistant. Be imaginative and original in your responses.
You are a helpful assistant. Provide balanced, informative responses.

commonSystemPrompts.technical: You are a senior software engineer providing technical assistance.
commonSystemPrompts.creative: You are a creative writing assistant focused on originality.
commonSystemPrompts.analytical: You are an analytical assistant providing data-driven insights.
commonSystemPrompts.educational: You are an expert teacher explaining concepts clearly.
commonSystemPrompts.conversational: You are a friendly, engaging conversational partner.
